I'm writing up the findings now. I couldn't open any page directly because the proxy refused every fetch, so everything below comes from search-result snippets. I left out all material dated after 2026-10-08.

## 1. Resolution source
- The source is Apple's US App Store iPhone Top Free chart, checked at 10:00 AM PT on 2026-10-15. The question gives no URL, so I could not pull a live or archived chart reading. Third-party trackers such as Sensor Tower, Appfigures and FoxData record daily ranks, but I couldn't reach them.
- 2026-09-28: there is a separate copycat app called "Muse AI" on the App Store. The question means Meta's Muse. [Michael Tsai](https://mjtsai.com/blog/2026/09/28/not-muse-in-the-app-store/)

## 2. Current status
- 2026-10-08: the question creator says Muse "just reached #1" in Top Free. That suggests it lost the top spot for a while and then got it back.
- Around 2026-10-06: a Startup Fortune report, as described in a search snippet, reportedly had Muse at No. 2 in the US. Around 2026-10-07, a report citing CNBC said Muse was still the top free iPhone app. I could not settle which was right. [Startup Fortune](https://startupfortune.com/how-alexandr-wang-pushed-meta-muse-to-no-1-in-the-app-store-ahead-of-chatgpt/)
- Nothing settles the question yet. It depends on a single snapshot a week away.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- Late Sept to early Oct 2026: coverage says Muse "dominating" the App Store, with Meta's stock rising on it. Commentators noted that its 7-day retention (about 30%) and 14-day retention (about 23%) are weak. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/meta-muse-dominating-app-store-144019978.html), [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/meta-muse-app-store-retention/)
- 2026-09-22: Meta shares jumped more than 11% after Muse topped the charts. Muse was No. 1 on both iOS and Google Play. Amazon blocked Muse's access to its platform. [PetaPixel](https://petapixel.com/2026/09/22/metas-stock-price-surges-as-muse-ai-tops-app-store-charts/)
- 2026-09-21: Sensor Tower says Muse is outpacing ChatGPT's early mobile launch, with about 730k downloads in its first 5 days and about 2.5M across iOS and Android by the following Monday. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/21/metas-muse-is-outpacing-chatgpts-early-mobile-launch/)
- 2026-09-18: Muse passed ChatGPT to become the No. 1 free iPhone app. [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/09/18/metas-new-muse-ai-agent-app-overtakes-chatgpt-as-top-iphone-app/), [Fox Business](https://www.foxbusiness.com/technology/metas-muse-becomes-app-stores-hottest-download)
- 2026-09-10: Muse reached No. 2 in the US two days after launch. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/10/metas-ai-agent-muse-is-now-the-no-2-app-in-the-us/)
- 2026-09-08: Muse launched. Paid tiers cost $20 or $100 a month. [Meta](https://ai.meta.com/muse/download/)

## 4. Base rates
- Muse has been No. 1 on most days since 2026-09-18, with at least one dip (reportedly No. 2 around 2026-10-06). I found no full daily record.
- Comparable cases:
  - 2025-10-03: OpenAI's Sora hit No. 1 in the US and held it for a few weeks before falling back. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2025/10/03/openais-sora-soars-to-no-1-on-the-u-s-app-store)
  - ChatGPT and DeepSeek both held No. 1 for long stretches during their surges.
  - Many AI apps have had explosive debuts and then faded. [TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262178990-muse-app-tops-app-store-chatgpt-meta-ai-agent-downloads-tradingkey)
- The Top Free #1 spot is often taken for a day or two by promotions, such as restaurant giveaways or ticket and streaming events. Even a dominant app can lose any single-day snapshot to one.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold prices for this question or a closely related one. The question itself looks like a Manifold-style market, but I couldn't see its current probability.

## 6. Upcoming events before 2026-10-15
- Dave's Hot Chicken runs an annual "Dave's Day" free-slider giveaway that requires downloading its app. In October 2025 it briefly took the overall No. 1 spot from Sora. If the 2026 giveaway falls near October 15, it is a direct threat to Muse's #1 at checkpoint time. I could not confirm the 2026 date from sources dated on or before 2026-10-08. [NRN](https://www.nrn.com/fast-casual/here-s-why-this-restaurant-chain-became-the-top-downloaded-iphone-app)
- Other possible threats are new AI launches or updates (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic), big sports or streaming events, and any Meta product news, such as a new Muse model or feature.
- Mid-October is also when iPhone holiday-season promotions start, which can bring sudden one-day download spikes for retail and food apps.

**Gaps:** I couldn't get a live or archived chart for October 8, any daily ranking history, or a market price.
